title: That Thing You Do!
note: mentioned by Van during Eddie and the Cruisers up, CR says it's a good rewatchable and Bill ponders if it should be added to the list
plot: A Pennsylvania band scores a hit in 1964 and rides the star-making machinery as long as it can, with lots of help from its manager. But behind the scenes, the group’s sudden fame tests their strength, their maturity and responsibility, and their ability to resist the temptations that money and notoriety always make possible.
